# Decisions: <module>

<!-- The permanent record of why this module is built the way it is. Lives next to SPEC.md as
     src/splintercam/<module>/DECISIONS.md. Rules: docs/dev/05, "Module decision records".
     - Write the entry in the same commit as the change that makes the decision, not at the end and not on request.
     - Newest last. IDs DEC-<MOD>-NNN are never reused.
     - After merge, only the Status line of an entry changes. A changed decision is a new entry that supersedes the old one.
     - Code that follows a decision a reader would not expect cites its ID in a comment. -->

## DEC-<MOD>-001: <short title>

- Date: <YYYY-MM-DD>; decided by: <Peter (D-nnn if registered) / ours (agent, inside the module)>
- Status: Active <or: Superseded by DEC-<MOD>-NNN on <date>>
- Decision: <what was chosen, one to three sentences>
- Why: <the reason; the requirement, test result, review finding or source that forced it>
- Rejected: <each alternative that was considered or is tempting, and why it was not taken>
- Where: <REQ IDs, files, tests that depend on it>
